title: Debug: running totals instead of row sums
prompt: `rowSums` compiles and returns the right *shape*, but each entry is a running total of the grid so far instead of that row's sum. Fix the accumulator placement (signature stays the same).

tests.name: row sums repaired
tests.code:
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.rowSums(new int[][] { {1, 2}, {10, 20} }), new int[] {3, 30}, "per-row, not cumulative");
CjTestBase.checkEq(Solution.rowSums(new int[][] { {5}, {5}, {5} }), new int[] {5, 5, 5}, "three equal rows");
tests.hint: move the accumulator declaration INSIDE the outer loop so each row starts from 0.
